title: Use only registered agricultural chemical products
what: Use or hold an agricultural chemical product only if it is registered, unless a permit authorises it.

laws.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Products (Control of Use) Act 2002 (SA)

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Products (Control of Use) Act 2002 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not use, or have in his or her possession or custody, an unregistered agricultural chemical product except as authorised by a permit
